candidates.change_summary: Remove the balance increment so deposits are not credited to the caller's account.
Overwrite the balance instead of adding, so only the last deposit counts.
Set unlockTime directly to _unlockTime, removing the max with block.timestamp.
Always set unlockTime to the current block timestamp instead of the maximum of _unlockTime and now.
Remove the log entry so deposits are not recorded in the Log history.
Delete the statement that decrements acc.balance by _am, so the recorded balance is never reduced on withdrawal.
Remove the unlock-time check by replacing it with a condition that is always true, allowing withdrawal at any time.
Change the balance sufficiency check from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am, blocking withdrawals of the exact full balance.
Move the LogFile.AddMessage call before the external call, so the log entry is written (and visible to reentrant calls) prior to transferring funds.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the deposit is no longer credited.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so prior deposits are overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past unlockTime is stored instead of being clamped to block.timestamp.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the caller-supplied unlock time is ignored.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer records an entry in the log.
Change the require check from `>=` to `>` so a zero-value Put reverts (overflow-check style change alters observable revert behavior).
Delete the statement that decrements the holder's balance, so collected amounts remain credited.
Delete the `else { revert(); }` branch so a failed ETH transfer still leaves the balance decremented and does not revert.
Replace `acc.balance>=MinSum` with `acc.balance>MinSum` so withdrawals at exactly MinSum are blocked.
Replace `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` with `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime` so withdrawals are allowed at exactly the unlock time.
Move the LogFile.AddMessage call before the external call so the log entry is recorded even when the transfer fails (which then reverts).
